records.source: וּבַחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֗דֶשׁ מִֽקְרָא־קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כָּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ י֥וֹם תְּרוּעָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃
records.gloss: And in the month the seventh, on one of the month, [a] convocation of holiness will be for you; any work of labor not you will do; [a] day of loud blast it will be for you.
pieces: On the first day of the seventh month you are to hold a holy assembly and do none of your ordinary work. It is a day for you when loud blasts are sounded.

L.1: And in the seventh month, on the first [day] of the month, a holy convocation shall be for you; any work of labor you shall not do; a day of loud blast it shall be for you.

R.1: On the first day of the seventh month, hold a holy gathering for worship. Do not do your everyday work. It is a day for sounding loud blasts.

decisions.choice: the first day of the seventh month: the new moon that opens the autumn festivals
decisions.reason: After the daily, Sabbath and new moon offerings and the spring festivals (28:3-31), the list turns to the seventh month, in September or October. Its first day is a new moon, so the offerings of 28:11-15 are also brought (verse 6). The month holds this day, the tenth day (verse 7) and the festival of verses 12-38, as in Leviticus 23:23-36.

decisions.choice: a holy convocation: a sacred gathering on a set day
decisions.reason: As in Leviticus 23:2 and Numbers 28:18, 25-26: the people are called together for worship on a day set apart for God.

decisions.choice: work of labor: ordinary daily work
decisions.reason: The phrase means the work of one's trade or livelihood, as in Leviticus 23:7, 25. It is less than the "any work" forbidden on the tenth day (verse 7).

decisions.choice: a day of loud blast: a day when horns or trumpets are sounded
decisions.reason: The word means a loud signal, a shout or the sound of horns and trumpets (Leviticus 23:24; Numbers 10:5-6). Leviticus 23:24 calls the day "a memorial of a loud blast", and Numbers 10:10 says trumpets are blown over the offerings at the festivals and new moons. The instrument is not named here.

decisions.choice: holy assembly / holy gathering for worship; ordinary work / everyday work
decisions.reason: As in Leviticus 23, Literal keeps "holy convocation" and "work of labor"; Balanced says "holy assembly" and "ordinary work", Readable "holy gathering for worship" and "everyday work", here and in verses 7, 12 and 35.

decisions.choice: a day ... when loud blasts are sounded
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn the noun phrase "a day of loud blast" into a clause, without naming the instrument, as at Leviticus 23:24.

records.heading: The day of trumpet blasts

records.source: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם עֹלָ֜ה לְרֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֨חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה פַּ֧ר בֶּן־בָּקָ֛ר אֶחָ֖ד אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָ֛ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה תְּמִימִֽם׃
records.gloss: And you will make [a] burnt offering for [an] aroma of soothing to Yahweh, [a] bull, [a] son of [the] herd, one, [a] ram, one, lambs, sons of [a] year, seven, unblemished.
pieces: Offer a burnt offering as a soothing aroma for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: one young bull, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, without defect.

L.2: And you shall offer a burnt offering for an aroma of soothing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: one bull, a young one of the herd, one ram, [and] seven male lambs a year old, unblemished.

R.2: Bring a burnt offering whose smell pleases {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: one young bull, one ram, and seven male lambs one year old. The lambs must have nothing wrong with them.

decisions.choice: one bull, one ram, seven lambs: the burnt offering of the day
decisions.reason: This is the set of animals given for each day of Unleavened Bread and for the day of firstfruits, except that those days have two bulls (28:19, 27). It is brought in addition to the new moon's own offerings (verse 6).

decisions.choice: a son of the herd; sons of a year: a young bull; lambs a year old
decisions.reason: "Son of" with a herd or with years names the animal's age: a young one of the cattle (15:8), and lambs in their first year (Exodus 12:5; 29:38).

decisions.choice: unblemished: without any defect
decisions.reason: An animal offered to God must be whole and sound, with no injury or deformity (Leviticus 22:19-25). For the burnt offering and the soothing aroma see 15:3.

decisions.choice: a young one of the herd
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase after "bull"; Balanced and Readable fold it into "young bull", as at Leviticus 23:18. Readable says the smell "pleases" the LORD for "an aroma of soothing" (15:3) and makes "unblemished" a sentence of its own.

records.source: וּמִנְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לַפָּ֔ר שְׁנֵ֥י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֖ים לָאָֽיִל׃
records.gloss: And their grain offering, fine flour mixed with the oil, three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the ram,
pieces: Their grain offering is to be fine flour mixed with oil: {{units:about 6 quarts|three tenths of an ephah}} for the bull, {{units:about 4 quarts|two tenths of an ephah}} for the ram,

L.3: And their grain offering [shall be] fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths [of an ephah] for the bull, two tenths for the ram,

R.3: Also bring their grain offering of fine flour mixed with olive oil. Bring {{units:about 6 quarts|three tenths of an ephah}} for the bull and {{units:about 4 quarts|two tenths of an ephah}} for the ram.

decisions.choice: three tenths for the bull, two for the ram, one for each lamb
decisions.reason: These are the amounts of 15:4-9 and 28:12-13, larger for a larger animal. A tenth means a tenth of an ephah, about two quarts, so three tenths is about six quarts. The oil and the wine of the drink offerings are not measured here; they follow the same scale (15:4-10; 28:14), and verse 6 names the drink offerings.

decisions.choice: about 6 quarts; about 4 quarts (units setting)
decisions.reason: As in 15:4-9, Balanced and Readable give modern measures, with the ancient ones as the alternative. Literal keeps "three tenths [of an ephah]". Readable says "olive oil", the oil used for offerings (Exodus 27:20).

records.source: וְעִשָּׂר֣וֹן אֶחָ֔ד לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד לְשִׁבְעַ֖ת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים׃
records.gloss: and [a] tenth one for the lamb the one, for [the] seven the lambs;
pieces: and {{units:about 2 quarts|a tenth of an ephah}} for each of the seven lambs.

L.4: and one tenth for each lamb, for the seven lambs;

R.4: Bring {{units:about 2 quarts|a tenth of an ephah}} for each of the seven lambs.

decisions.choice: for the one lamb, for the seven lambs: a tenth for each of the seven
decisions.reason: "The one" has the sense "each", as in 15:5: each lamb has its own tenth, seven tenths in all for the seven lambs.

decisions.choice: about 2 quarts (units setting)
decisions.reason: As in verse 3 and 15:4.

records.source: וּשְׂעִיר־עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את לְכַפֵּ֖ר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
records.gloss: And [a] male goat of goats, one, [a] sin offering, to make atonement for you,
pieces: Offer also one male goat as a sin offering, to make atonement for you,

L.5: and one male goat [as] a sin offering, to make atonement for you,

R.5: Also offer one male goat as a sin offering, to make atonement for you.

decisions.choice: a sin offering, to make atonement for you: for the whole people
decisions.reason: Every festival day has one goat as a sin offering for the people as a whole (28:15, 22, 30). For the sin offering see Leviticus 4:22-24, and for "make atonement" Leviticus 1:4. The "you" is plural: all Israel.

decisions.choice: a male goat of goats: a he-goat
decisions.reason: The phrase names a male of the goats, the usual animal for the people's sin offering (Leviticus 9:3; 16:5).

records.source: מִלְּבַד֩ עֹלַ֨ת הַחֹ֜דֶשׁ וּמִנְחָתָ֗הּ וְעֹלַ֤ת הַתָּמִיד֙ וּמִנְחָתָ֔הּ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֖ם כְּמִשְׁפָּטָ֑ם לְרֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃ס
records.gloss: besides [the] burnt offering of the new moon and its grain offering, and [the] burnt offering of the continuity and its grain offering, and their drink offerings according to their ordinance, for [an] aroma of soothing, [an] offering by fire to Yahweh.
pieces: in addition to the burnt offering of the new moon with its grain offering, and the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings, as prescribed for them. They are a soothing aroma, a food offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

L.6: besides the burnt offering of the new moon and its grain offering, and the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for an aroma of soothing, an offering by fire to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

R.6: All these are in addition to the burnt offering and grain offering for the new moon, and the daily burnt offering with its grain offering, and the drink offerings that go with them. Offer them all as the rules say. These food offerings burned on the altar make a smell that pleases {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

decisions.choice: besides: the day's offerings are added to the others
decisions.reason: This day is both a new moon and a festival, so three sets of offerings are brought: the daily burnt offering of morning and evening (28:3-8), the new moon's offerings (28:11-15) and the offerings of verses 2-5. None replaces another.

decisions.choice: the continuity: the burnt offering offered every day without a break
decisions.reason: The word means what is constant or regular. It names the lamb offered each morning and each evening (28:3-8; Exodus 29:38-42).

decisions.choice: according to their ordinance: in the amounts the law sets for them
decisions.reason: The rule is the scale of grain and wine for each kind of animal (15:1-12; 28:12-14). For "an offering by fire" and "an aroma of soothing" see 15:3.

decisions.choice: regular / daily burnt offering; food offering
decisions.reason: As at Exodus 29:42, Literal says "continual", Balanced "regular" and Readable "daily". Balanced and Readable say "food offering" for "offering by fire", as in 15:3.

records.source: וּבֶעָשׂוֹר֩ לַחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י הַזֶּ֗ה מִֽקְרָא־קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם וְעִנִּיתֶ֖ם אֶת־נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם כָּל־מְלָאכָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃
records.gloss: And on [the] tenth of the month the seventh the this [a] convocation of holiness will be for you, and you will afflict your souls; any work not you will do.
pieces: On the tenth day of this seventh month you are to hold a holy assembly. Humble yourselves by fasting, and do no work of any kind.

L.7: And on the tenth [day] of this seventh month a holy convocation shall be for you, and you shall afflict yourselves; any work you shall not do.

R.7: On the tenth day of this seventh month, hold a holy gathering for worship. This is the Day of Atonement. Go without food and humble yourselves. Do not do any work at all.

decisions.choice: the tenth day of the seventh month: the Day of Atonement
decisions.reason: The day is not named here, but it is the day of Leviticus 16:29-34 and 23:26-32, when atonement is made for the sanctuary and the people. Verse 11 refers to its own sin offering.

decisions.choice: afflict your souls: humble yourselves before God, above all by fasting
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "your souls", meaning your own selves. The phrase is used of fasting (Psalm 35:13; Isaiah 58:3, 5), as in Leviticus 16:29.

decisions.choice: any work: no work at all
decisions.reason: Unlike verses 1, 12 and 35, which forbid only ordinary work, this day forbids every kind of work, as on the Sabbath (Leviticus 23:3, 28).

decisions.choice: humble yourselves by fasting / go without food and humble yourselves
decisions.reason: As in Leviticus 16:29 and 23:27. Literal keeps "afflict yourselves", with "your souls" in the gloss.

decisions.choice: This is the Day of Atonement.
decisions.reason: Readable names the day, which the text identifies only by its date, so that the reader knows which day is meant (Leviticus 23:27).

records.heading: The tenth day of the seventh month

records.source: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עֹלָ֤ה לַֽיהוָה֙ רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ פַּ֧ר בֶּן־בָּקָ֛ר אֶחָ֖ד אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד כְּבָשִׂ֤ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָה֙ שִׁבְעָ֔ה תְּמִימִ֖ם יִהְי֥וּ לָכֶֽם׃
records.gloss: And you will bring near [a] burnt offering to Yahweh, [an] aroma of soothing, [a] bull, [a] son of [the] herd, one, [a] ram, one, lambs, sons of [a] year, seven; unblemished they will be for you.
pieces: Present to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} a burnt offering as a soothing aroma: one young bull, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old. See that they are all without defect.

L.8: And you shall bring near a burnt offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, an aroma of soothing: one bull, a young one of the herd, one ram, [and] seven male lambs a year old; they shall be unblemished for you.

R.8: Bring a burnt offering whose smell pleases {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: one young bull, one ram, and seven male lambs one year old. None of them may have anything wrong with them.

decisions.choice: the same burnt offering as on the first day
decisions.reason: The animals are those of verse 2. They are brought in addition to the special rites of the day (Leviticus 16) and the daily offering (verse 11).

decisions.choice: unblemished they shall be for you: all the animals
decisions.reason: The words close the list and apply to every animal in it, as in 28:19 and 28:31.

records.source: וּמִנְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לַפָּ֔ר שְׁנֵי֙ עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים לָאַ֖יִל הָאֶחָֽד׃
records.gloss: And their grain offering, fine flour mixed with the oil, three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the ram the one,
pieces: Their grain offering is to be fine flour mixed with oil: {{units:about 6 quarts|three tenths of an ephah}} for the bull, {{units:about 4 quarts|two tenths of an ephah}} for the ram,

L.9: And their grain offering [shall be] fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths [of an ephah] for the bull, two tenths for the one ram,

R.9: Also bring their grain offering of fine flour mixed with olive oil. Bring {{units:about 6 quarts|three tenths of an ephah}} for the bull and {{units:about 4 quarts|two tenths of an ephah}} for the ram.

decisions.choice: the amounts of verse 3
decisions.reason: As in verse 3.

decisions.choice: about 6 quarts; about 4 quarts (units setting)
decisions.reason: As in verse 3.

records.source: עִשָּׂרוֹן֙ עִשָּׂר֔וֹן לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד לְשִׁבְעַ֖ת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים׃
records.gloss: [a] tenth, [a] tenth for the lamb the one, for [the] seven the lambs;
pieces: and {{units:about 2 quarts|a tenth of an ephah}} for each of the seven lambs.

L.10: a tenth, a tenth for each lamb, for the seven lambs;

R.10: Bring {{units:about 2 quarts|a tenth of an ephah}} for each of the seven lambs.

decisions.choice: a tenth, a tenth: a tenth for each one
decisions.reason: Saying the word twice gives the sense "a tenth each". The amount is the same as in verse 4, where the Hebrew says "one tenth".

decisions.choice: about 2 quarts (units setting)
decisions.reason: As in verse 4.

records.source: שְׂעִיר־עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את מִלְּבַ֞ד חַטַּ֤את הַכִּפֻּרִים֙ וְעֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד וּמִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃פ
records.gloss: [A] male goat of goats, one, [a] sin offering, besides [the] sin offering of the atonements and [the] burnt offering of the continuity and its grain offering, and their drink offerings.
pieces: Offer also one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering for atonement, and the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.

L.11: One male goat [as] a sin offering, besides the sin offering of atonement and the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, and their drink offerings.

R.11: Also offer one male goat as a sin offering. All these are in addition to the sin offering that makes atonement on this day, and the daily burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

decisions.choice: the sin offering of atonement: the special sin offering of this day
decisions.reason: This is the sin offering of the Day of Atonement rite: the bull for the high priest and the goat for the people whose blood is taken into the Most Holy Place (Leviticus 16:3, 5, 9, 11, 15). The goat of this verse is a further one, brought like those of the other festival days (verse 5).

decisions.choice: besides: the day's offerings are added to the others
decisions.reason: As in verse 6. Here the list names the day's special sin offering and the daily burnt offering.

decisions.choice: that makes atonement on this day
decisions.reason: Readable explains the name "sin offering of atonement" as the sin offering that belongs to the Day of Atonement.

records.source: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֜וֹם לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י מִֽקְרָא־קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כָּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ וְחַגֹּתֶ֥ם חַ֛ג לַיהוָ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
records.gloss: And on [the] fifteen day of the month the seventh [a] convocation of holiness will be for you; any work of labor not you will do, and you will celebrate [a] festival to Yahweh seven days.
pieces: On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you are to hold a holy assembly and do none of your ordinary work. Celebrate a festival for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for seven days.

L.12: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month a holy convocation shall be for you; any work of labor you shall not do, and you shall celebrate a festival to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} seven days.

R.12: On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, hold a holy gathering for worship. Do not do your everyday work. This is the Festival of Booths. For seven days, celebrate a festival to honor {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

decisions.choice: the fifteenth of the seventh month: the Festival of Booths
decisions.reason: The festival is not named here, but it is the one of Leviticus 23:34-43, when Israel lived in booths for seven days at the end of the harvest. Exodus 23:16 calls it the Festival of Ingathering.

decisions.choice: celebrate a festival: keep a pilgrimage feast
decisions.reason: The verb and noun name one of the three yearly feasts at which all Israel's men were to appear before the LORD (Exodus 23:14-17; Deuteronomy 16:16), a time of joy (Deuteronomy 16:14-15).

decisions.choice: work of labor: ordinary work
decisions.reason: As in verse 1.

decisions.choice: This is the Festival of Booths.
decisions.reason: Readable names the festival, which the text identifies only by its date (Leviticus 23:34). Readable says "to honor" for "to the LORD", as at Leviticus 23:34.

records.heading: The seven-day festival of the seventh month

records.source: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עֹלָ֜ה אִשֵּׁ֨ה רֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֨חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי־בָקָ֛ר שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִ֥ם יִהְיֽוּ׃
records.gloss: And you will bring near [a] burnt offering, [an] offering by fire of [an] aroma of soothing to Yahweh, bulls, sons of [the] herd, thirteen, rams, two, lambs, sons of [a] year, fourteen; unblemished they will be.
pieces: Present a burnt offering, a food offering with a soothing aroma for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: thirteen young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old. They are to be without defect.

L.13: And you shall bring near a burnt offering, an offering by fire of an aroma of soothing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: thirteen bulls, young ones of the herd, two rams, [and] fourteen male lambs a year old; they shall be unblemished.

R.13: Bring a burnt offering as a food offering burned on the altar, with a smell that pleases {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Bring thirteen young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs one year old. None of them may have anything wrong with them.

decisions.choice: thirteen bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs: the largest offering of the year
decisions.reason: On each day of this festival the rams and lambs are twice the number of the other festivals (verse 2; 28:19), and the bulls begin at thirteen and fall by one each day to seven on the seventh day (verse 32). Over the seven days that makes seventy bulls, fourteen rams and ninety-eight lambs. Later Jewish tradition linked the seventy bulls with the seventy nations of Genesis 10.

decisions.choice: an offering by fire of an aroma of soothing: a gift on the altar that God accepts
decisions.reason: See 15:3. The two phrases are joined here: the burnt offering is a gift burned on the altar whose smoke God accepts with pleasure.

decisions.choice: food offering
decisions.reason: As in verse 6 and 15:3. Readable adds "burned on the altar" to say what the word means.

records.source: וּמִנְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֜ים לַפָּ֣ר הָֽאֶחָ֗ד לִשְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ פָּרִ֔ים שְׁנֵ֤י עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לָאַ֣יִל הָֽאֶחָ֔ד לִשְׁנֵ֖י הָאֵילִֽם׃
records.gloss: And their grain offering, fine flour mixed with the oil, three tenths for the bull the one, for [the] thirteen bulls, two tenths for the ram the one, for [the] two the rams,

decisions.choice: besides the continual burnt offering: as in verse 16
decisions.reason: As in verse 16. Here the Hebrew says "their drink offerings" where verse 16 has "its drink offering"; the sense is the same, the drink offerings that go with the daily burnt offering.

decisions.choice: their drink offerings: an unusual spelling noticed by later tradition
decisions.reason: The plural forms in this verse, in verse 31 ("its drink offerings") and in verse 33 ("their ordinance") each have a letter not found in the matching words of the other days. Jewish tradition (Babylonian Talmud, Ta'anit 2b) noticed that these extra letters, taken together, spell the word for "water", and read them as a hint of the water poured out at the altar during this festival. The text itself does not mention a water offering.

pieces: Present a burnt offering, a food offering with a soothing aroma for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: one bull, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, without defect,

L.36: And you shall bring near a burnt offering, an offering by fire of an aroma of soothing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: one bull, one ram, [and] seven male lambs a year old, unblemished,

R.36: Bring a burnt offering as a food offering burned on the altar, with a smell that pleases {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Bring one bull, one ram, and seven male lambs one year old. None of them may have anything wrong with them.

decisions.choice: one bull, one ram, seven lambs: back to the size of the first and tenth days
decisions.reason: After the seven days of many bulls, the eighth day has the same burnt offering as the first and tenth days of the month (verses 2, 8). The wording of the burnt offering is that of verse 13.

decisions.choice: food offering
decisions.reason: As in verse 13.

records.source: מִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֗ם לַפָּ֨ר לָאַ֧יִל וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
records.gloss: Their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance,
pieces: with their grain offerings and drink offerings for the bull, the ram and the lambs, according to their number, as prescribed,

L.37: their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance,

R.37: Bring the grain offerings and drink offerings for the bull, the ram and the lambs, the right amount for each animal, as the rules say.

decisions.choice: by their number, according to the ordinance: the set amount for each animal
decisions.reason: As in verse 18, here for one bull and one ram.

records.source: וּשְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד וּמִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃
records.gloss: and [a] male goat of sin offering, one, besides [the] burnt offering of the continuity, and its grain offering and its drink offering.
pieces: and one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

L.38: and one male goat [as] a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering and its grain offering and its drink offering.

R.38: Also offer one male goat as a sin offering. All these are in addition to the daily burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

decisions.choice: one male goat as a sin offering, besides the daily offering
decisions.reason: As in verse 16, and with "a male goat of sin offering" as in verse 22.

records.source: אֵ֛לֶּה תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה בְּמוֹעֲדֵיכֶ֑ם לְבַ֨ד מִנִּדְרֵיכֶ֜ם וְנִדְבֹתֵיכֶ֗ם לְעֹלֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ וּלְמִנְחֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וּלְנִסְכֵּיכֶ֖ם וּלְשַׁלְמֵיכֶֽם׃
records.gloss: These you will offer to Yahweh at your appointed times, besides your vows and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings and for your grain offerings and for your drink offerings and for your peace offerings.
pieces: These are the offerings you are to bring to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at your appointed festivals, in addition to your vow offerings and your freewill offerings, whether burnt offerings, grain offerings, drink offerings or peace offerings.'"

L.39: These you shall offer to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at your appointed times, besides your vows and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings and for your grain offerings and for your drink offerings and for your peace offerings.'"

R.39: Offer all these to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at your special festivals. They are separate from the offerings you promised and the offerings you choose to give, whether these are burnt offerings, grain offerings, drink offerings or peace offerings.'"

decisions.choice: these you shall offer at your appointed times: the close of the calendar
decisions.reason: The words sum up the offerings for the set times listed from 28:2 on and end the speech that began there. The next verse in the Hebrew text (30:1, numbered 29:40 in many Bibles) tells how Moses passed it on to Israel.

decisions.choice: for your burnt offerings ... peace offerings: the kinds of offering that vows and freewill gifts may take
decisions.reason: The list probably names the forms the people's own vows and freewill offerings may take (Leviticus 22:18-23; Numbers 15:3, 8). It could instead name the kinds of fixed offering just listed, as what Israel is to offer at the appointed times. Either way the calendar offerings are added to the people's own gifts, not in place of them (Leviticus 23:37-38).

decisions.choice: your vows, your freewill offerings: offerings a person chooses to bring
decisions.reason: A vow offering keeps a promise made to God; a freewill offering is given from a willing heart (Leviticus 7:16; 22:18-23). They are not fixed by the calendar.

decisions.choice: appointed festivals / special festivals; the offerings you promised / you choose to give
decisions.reason: As in Leviticus 23:2 and 23:38. Literal keeps "appointed times" and "vows".
